title: Iran Says Qatar Captured Its Pilots Months Ago, a Claim Qatar Rejects
summary: Iran said the airmen have been held since March 2 when their fighter jets were shot down. The Qatari government denies detaining any Iranian pilots.
body_markdown: Iran said the airmen have been held since March 2 when their fighter jets were shot down. The Qatari government denies detaining any Iranian pilots.
